static_traits.name: Chen Jie
static_traits.family_status: Father曾从事石膏板施工Work，Mother为注册Nurse（RN）
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系因频繁寻求Work安全感的保证而趋于紧张；拥有一位亲密朋友可谈心，但尚not yet就WorkFear进行交流
static_traits.medical_history: not yet曾出现类似心理问题，not yet接受心理治疗；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, relatively high cooperation; tone rather negative, repeatedly emphasizing worries; tending to focus on negative feedback and finding it hard to accept positive information; has a tendency to seek reassurance

basic_info.main_problem: 我对老板最终会解雇我存在持续性Fear，尽管我在Technician岗位表现Good。这种失去Work的Fear正在造成显著的压力与Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: The fear of losing my job has begun to affect my work performance and overall physical and mental state, so I now seek counseling to relieve this fear and improve performance and well-being.
growth_experiences: 入职数月后因几次小失误开始产生被解雇的Fear；近期公司因重组发生裁员，使该Fear显著加剧。此后几乎每日在收到主管反馈或公司会议时被trigger，逐步影响睡眠、饮食与Work表现。
家庭背景：Father为石膏板施工工人，Mother为注册Nurse；not yet报告重大躯体或心理疾病史，not yet接受过心理治疗。

core_beliefs: 我在Work中not安全，迟早会被解雇
Small mistakes determine my worth and whether I stay

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the company starts layoffs, I will eventually be laid off too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 保持高度警觉、not断担忧并尝试用自我安慰缓解，但效果短暂
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be the next one laid off

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 任何负面意见都意味着我not称职并会被解雇
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Only focuses on the negative parts, ignores positive evaluations; doubles work to seek recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们对我not满意，这次反馈是在铺垫解雇

special_situations.event: A few small mistakes early in the new job
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果犯错，就说明我not合格，早晚会被解雇
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly recalls mistakes to stay alert to myself, and seeks positive feedback from colleagues to comfort myself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those mistakes will be remembered and become the reason to fire me

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面反馈not可靠，not能说明我安全
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 贬低或deny积极信息，继续寻求更多保证
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些好话not算数，我仍然可能被解雇

core_conflict.wish: Longs for a stable, safe and recognized work position
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected/被抛弃（被解雇），失去价值与生计
defense_goal: 通过持续警觉与寻求保证来降低not确定性，避免被突然裁员

object_relations.self_representation: not稳定、随时可能被淘汰的下属
object_relations.object_representation: A picky, controlling superior/organization that may lay people off at any time

object_relations.self_representation: The person who needs others' affirmation to feel safe
object_relations.object_representation: 能提供短暂安慰但not可靠的同事

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about company layoffs, reviewing small mistakes, or receiving constructive feedback from a supervisor
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将建设性反馈视为负面预兆，把not确定性理解为迫近的危险
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Repeatedly listing past small mistakes and company restructuring as grounds for fear in a calm, rational tone, weakening positive evidence, emphasizing 'risk', and demanding more guarantees.

manifestations: not愿向亲密朋友分享WorkFear以免显得在抱怨或without法自我处理
Relationships with colleagues are strained by seeking reassurance, subjectively feeling alienated from others
outcomes: Decline in work performance与职场Increased stress

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact
manifestations: In feedback situations, bypasses the positive content and quickly turns to negative possibilities or layoff risks
Hard to stay with positive evaluations; quickly returns to worry topics

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection和反省能力，包含Excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, overly cautious about contact
manifestations: 担心显得在抱怨或not能自我处理问题而not向好友求助
在同事间频繁寻求保证后Self-denial，进一步限制表达与求助

positive_force: 总体岗位表现Good，能够获得主管与同事的建设性及正面反馈
Willing to try challenging my thinking and accept reality testing (open attitude toward the counseling plan)
Having a close friend who can provide potential support
negative_force: 灾难化、预测not yet来、心理过滤与negate积极信息的认知倾向
对not确定性高度敏感且Persistent anxiety
过度寻求保证导致同事Relationship tension
Sleep and diet affected、Decline in work performance
not yet主动利用现有Social support（尚not yet与朋友讨论该问题）

target_behavior.behavior: 与Work相关的Persistent anxiety与强烈的被解雇Fear
antecedent: Receiving constructive feedback from a supervisor
Company meetings or information related to restructuring/layoffs
Recalling a few small mistakes from early employment
target_behavior.core_reason: 将早期小失误与公司裁员事件灾难化、过度概括，并预测not yet来最坏结果，形成“迟早会被解雇”的核心信念
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定性与感知到的危险，寻求外部保证以暂时缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance、Tense relationships with colleagues、Sleep and diet affected、几乎每日反复担忧
